biotools.summary: Free web form that checks whether a DNA or RNA sample is likely to pass a sequencing provider’s sample QC. Enter the sample type, concentration, volume, measuring method, A260/280, A260/230, integrity and buffer; each value is reported as Looks OK, Borderline or Likely problem, with what to fix. It runs entirely in the browser: no sign-up, and your numbers are not sent anywhere. Ranges are general guidance; the provider’s own requirements come first.
